verdict.rationale: Direct DOM access for integrating third-party libraries is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents it. Nothing covers template refs, lifecycle hooks or custom directives for wrapping charting or visualization libraries. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: generic "builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript" marketing, gradual adoption into existing pages, and a community mention of component refs ($childRef) rather than DOM element access.
